description: Adds N working days to an ISO instant, skipping Saturdays and Sundays by UTC calendar date; the time of day is preserved. Used by lab escalation (5 working days, БП-2). days=0 returns the input unchanged even if it falls on a weekend.

cases.name: add 1 working day from Thursday - lands on Friday
add 2 working days from Thursday - skips the weekend
add 1 working day from Friday - skips straight to Monday
add 3 working days from Friday - spans the weekend
lab escalation case - 5 working days from Monday (БП-2)
starting from a Saturday - counts from the following Monday
starting from a Sunday - counts from the following Monday
zero working days - returns the same instant unchanged
zero working days from a weekend start - unchanged even though not a working day
crosses a month boundary through a weekend
spans two weekends over ten working days
time of day is preserved exactly including milliseconds
